title: Four real points and M̄₀,₅(ℝ)
hook: Four points on a line give a point in the moduli space of 5 points (where the fifth point is infinity)
alt: Four numbered dots slide along a line. Beside them a red dot wanders across a disk cut by curved lines into twelve labelled cells, filling the cell it is in; four small dashed circles sit where three lines would meet, and a line brightens as the dot approaches it.
author: @zhongzhang-math

presets.label: Blow-up on: 12 pentagons
presets.note: Every cell has five sides: two of them lie on dashed circles.

presets.label: Blow-up off: 12 triangles
presets.note: Three lines cross at each of four points, and every cell is a triangle.
